technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
The dataset represents the production mix of commercial PET production technologies in Europe

# Included processes
The polymer process, upstream processes like pX, PTA, and MEG production, electricity, and steam production as well as transportation of feedstock and waste treatment.
